name: Nebuzaradan
bio: Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard under Nebuchadnezzar, came to Jerusalem a month after its walls were breached and burned the temple, the royal palace, and every great house in the city, while the Chaldean army tore down the walls. He deported most of the remaining population, leaving only the poorest to work the land, and carried off the temple's bronze and precious-metal vessels, including the great bronze pillars and the bronze sea that Solomon had made. He also seized Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and other officials and citizens, who were executed by Nebuchadnezzar at Riblah (2 Kings 25:8-21).
